name: Cinder Juggler
flavor: Six clubs in the air and every one of them alight; the fire has been going round so long it has forgotten how to land.
acNote: loose motley, and it is watching the clubs, not you

features.name: Keep the Cascade
features.description: It may throw two Lit Clubs on its turn instead of one, but only if it does not move that turn. Break its footing and the cascade breaks with it.

tactics: It plants itself at range and burns. The counter is written into it: make it move. Anything that shoves, hauls or frightens it costs it half its damage that turn.
narration: The clubs go round without a sound, and then one of them is not going round any more.
